meta.title: Vendor Extension: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Open Vendor Extension for an existing vendor and extend it to a new organization or plant while reusing its code.
Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and verify the action is refused or absent.
Repeat the action as a Buyer and verify it is available.
Compare the two role-specific outcomes while accounting for tenant RBAC configuration and Enterprise plan access.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open Vendor Extension for an existing vendor and extend it to a new organization or plant while reusing its code.; Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and verify the action is refused or absent.; Repeat the action as a Buyer and verify it is available.; Compare the two role-specific outcomes while accounting for tenant RBAC configuration and Enterprise plan access.

args.need: sign in as the non-Buyer user and the Buyer in the same Enterprise tenant, attempt Vendor Extension for an existing vendor to a new organization or plant reusing its code, and compare whether the action is refused or absent for the non-Buyer but available to the Buyer

steps.note: The catalog cannot navigate Vendor Extension or switch between role-specific users, so the tester must perform the role comparison and record any tenant RBAC configuration.
Confirm the session remains free of crashes or server errors after the tester's interaction.
